run_mrp_processes: run mrp.main() to start all defined processes from the msetup.py configuration file
define_conda_process: define a named process using mrp.Conda with python dependencies and a run command
define_docker_process: define a named process using mrp.Docker with a specific container image like ubuntu or python
attach_to_running_process: attach to a running mrp process using the mrp attach command for interactive I/O
list_defined_processes: list all mrp processes defined in msetup.py using the mrp ps command
